svg.title: XIAO RP2350 Bar Graph Physical Breadboard Wiring
svg.desc: Complete solderless breadboard wiring diagram for the Seeed Studio XIAO RP2350, 10 kOhm potentiometer on D0, optional 100 nF capacitor, and 6 active-high LEDs with 330 Ohm resistors on D3, D4, D5, D8, D9, and D10.

text.font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Physical Breadboard Wiring: XIAO RP2350 6-LED Bar Graph

text.font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 28-column breadboard layout — strictly 3.3 V logic (never connect 5V), skipping D1/D2 (ADC my_reset) and D6/D7 (UART0).

svg.text: + Anode (long leg) in row e → - Cathode (flat rim) in row f

text.font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each cathode shares strip f–j with a 330 Ω resistor to GND (-)

text.font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bit order: bit 0 = LED 1 (D3) ... bit 5 = LED 6 (D10)
